olbg_irregularities.title: Silent GeoIP Clock Localization to US EDT (UTC-4) Without Timezone Labels
olbg_irregularities.detail: When queried from US infrastructure, OLBG server-renders timestamps in US Eastern Daylight Time (UTC-4) with zero timezone badge, creating grotesque self-contradictions directly beside UK BST event titles—e.g. '11:14 Kinsley' (10:14 UTC) displays 'Today 06:14', and '10:32 Harlow' displays 'Today 05:32'.

olbg_irregularities.scope: Gaelic Football — Rathgormack v The Nire (event_id=3536)
olbg_irregularities.title: County Final Scheduled One Full Week Late on OLBG ('01 Nov 10:30')
olbg_irregularities.detail: OLBG lists the Waterford Senior Football Championship Final for Sunday 1 November, seven days after the official Munster GAA fixture date of Sunday 25 October 2026 at 14:30 UTC at Fraher Field, Dungarvan.

olbg_irregularities.title: Each-Way-Only Division-by-Zero Display Bug ('0 / 0 Win Tips — 0%')
olbg_irregularities.detail: On Hero Women's Indian Open (Avani Prashanth) and T20 Blast 2027 (Sussex), tipsters staked Each-Way tips without Win-only tips, causing OLBG's card component to render '0 / 0 Win Tips (0%)' while still promoting a top selection.

olbg_irregularities.title: Complete Zero-Match Blind Spot Across Three Active Major Championships
olbg_irregularities.detail: OLBG displays 0 active match markets across Rugby League, Aussie Rules, and eSports while RLWC26 Round 2 (7 Tests on nrl.com), NAB AFLW Round 11 (9 matches on afl.com.au), and LoL Worlds 2026 Swiss Stage (lolesports.com) are actively in progress—alongside stale 2023 AFL and CS:GO/FIFA boilerplate copy.

olbg_irregularities.title: Severe Cumulative Stale-Tip Distortion on Season-Long Outrights
olbg_irregularities.detail: OLBG aggregates un-decayed pre-season tips alongside October tips, leaving Max Verstappen (4th on 221 pts) as OLBG's #1 Championship tip ahead of runaway leader Kimi Antonelli (340 pts, +119 cushion on formula1.com) AND ahead of George Russell (238 pts) in the 'Without Antonelli' market.

olbg_irregularities.title: Systematic Tipster Competition Gaming on 8/1–14/1 Handball 60m Draws
olbg_irregularities.detail: Because OLBG tipster tables rank by theoretical level-stake profit, 43%–80% of tips on lopsided EHF ties (e.g. 4/5 on Aalborg vs 0-0-4 Celje; 3/6 on Kolstad vs 4-0-0 Magdeburg) back the 60-minute Tie despite a ~6–10% true base rate.

olbg_irregularities.title: Top-Level Sport Hub Truncates Active Events Behind Sub-Route Silos
olbg_irregularities.detail: Querying only /betting-tips/Basketball/4 omits live NBA, EuroLeague, EuroCup, and BCL fixtures visible only when crawling /Basketball/NBA/4 and /Basketball/European/4.

olbg_irregularities.title: Missing Tournament Header Metadata on Individual Match Cards
olbg_irregularities.detail: OLBG strips tournament names under generic 'All_Events' URLs across Tennis and Snooker, requiring cross-referencing against ATP, WTA, and WST draws to separate Ningbo, Osaka, Almaty, Lyon, and Brussels ties.

olbg_irregularities.title: Broadcast Warmup vs Official Puck-Drop / Tip-Off Minute Drift (+7 to +10 mins)
olbg_irregularities.detail: OLBG lists NHL puck drops at :37 past the hour ('19:37' vs api-web.nhle.com 23:30 UTC) and NBA games at :10/:40 past the hour vs official top/half-hour NBA schedule slots.

olbg_irregularities.scope: Gaelic Football — Kanturk v Éire Óg (event_id=3531)
olbg_irregularities.title: Unconfirmed Club Fixture Held Strictly as 'Unverified'
olbg_irregularities.detail: OLBG lists 'Kanturk v Eire Og Cor' for 01 Nov 09:00, which does not appear on the Cork Premier Senior FC Final card (St Finbarr's v Nemo Rangers); start UTC and venue are left blank and flagged unverified.

olbg_irregularities.title: Deprecated Pre-Merger Club Naming ('Skanderborg Handbold' vs 'SAH - Aarhus')
olbg_irregularities.detail: OLBG displays legacy 'Skanderborg Handbold' rather than official EHF club name 'SAH - Aarhus' (Skanderborg-Aarhus Håndbold), which misled prior session 2360a617 into falsely claiming the club was outside the EHF CL.

olbg_irregularities.title: Single-Selection Summary Without Trap Numbers & HTTP 404 Public GBGB API
olbg_irregularities.detail: OLBG hub cards expose only the single most-tipped runner per race without full 6-dog trap sheets, and api.gbgb.org.uk/api/results/meeting?date=2026-10-21 returned HTTP 404; runner form fields are left blank and flagged unverified.
